defects.claim_says: The catalog See note to Transfer Order 30 of the Secretary of Defense dated December 10, 1948 is a cross-reference whose text is not held and which no held source describes as an ending; only EO 9242-A and EO 14085 name the order apart from reprints and the 1948 and 1954 concordance pages.
defects.source_says: Transfer Order 30 is held: jobs/cruden-fr-concordance/output/texts/FR-1948-12-21_p39_734bd5b6ca34.txt (text_sha256 734bd5b6ca344526be0007f4a8d1cfb8f49cd73ba1d6fb1d190fa0b18560c94d; OCR of govinfo FR-1948-12-21.pdf sha256 250ea0c6..., GPO PREMIS match), 13 FR 8163. It transferred to the Secretary of the Air Force, effective 12:00 noon December 10, 1948, the Secretary of the Army's functions relating to decorations and awards for acts or services with the Air Corps, Army Air Forces or Air Force, vested by or under item k, 'Executive Order No. 9158 of May 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 3541), as amended by Executive Order No. 9242-A'. That is a held later instrument acting on the award authority in the order's second paragraph; the claim misdescribes it as not held and records no later event for it. It does not end the order.
